text: The Shadowlands Map is located in the center of the Enclave in Oribos. It was put in place long ago by the First Ones, and its magic can establish a connection to the mortal plane if connected to an object from said plane. After arriving in Oribos, the Maw Walker affixes a fragment of the Helm of Domination to the map in order to establish a link to Azeroth. __NOTOC__
Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season One is a feat of strength achievement earned by completing all Shadowlands Season One dungeons at Mythic Level 15 or higher, within the time limit.
Shadowlands Keystone Conqueror: Season One is a feat of strength achievement earned by completing all Shadowlands Season One dungeons at Mythic Level 10 or higher, within the time limit.
__NOTOC__ Shadowbreaker Urzula is a jungle troll located in Island Expeditions.
Shadowlaced Armaments is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadowed Shortblade is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadowlands Keystone Explorer: Season One is a feat of strength achievement earned by completing all Shadowlands Season One dungeons at Mythic Level 5 or higher, within the time limit.
Shadowflame Prism is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Prism of Shadow and Fire.
Shadowlands Keystone Conqueror: Season Two is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 1500 during Shadowlands Season Two.
Shadowlands Keystone Explorer: Season Two is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 750 during Shadowlands Season Two.
Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Two is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 2000 during Shadowlands Season Two.
Shadowbreaker, Dawn of the Sun is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Shadowbreaker.
Shadowlands Keystone Explorer: Season Three is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 900 during Shadowlands Season Three.
Shadowlands Keystone Conqueror: Season Three is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 1850 during Shadowlands Season Three.
Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Three is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 2500 during Shadowlands Season 3.
Shadowlands Keystone Hero: Season Three is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 3000 during Shadowlands Season Three.
Shadowlands Keystone Explorer: Season Four is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 750 during Shadowlands Season Four.
Shadowlands Keystone Conqueror: Season Four is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 1500 during Shadowlands Season Four.
Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Four is a feat of strength achievement earned by attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 2000 during Shadowlands Season 4.
Shadowflame Crests introduces players to the other half of Dragonflight Season 2 PvE gear upgrades: Shadowflame Crests.
Shaina Fuller is a first aid trainer located in the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
The following NPCs can be found in Shadowmoon Valley of Outland.
Shadowstep is a rogue talent. It teleports the player behind a target and gives them a short movement speed increase buff.
Shadowmoon Summoners are fel orcs found in the Blood Furnace. They summon Felhound Manastalkers and/or Seductresses. Killing them grants 5 reputation with Thrallmar or Honor Hold.
Shadowmoon Warlocks can be found in the Blood Furnace. They are worth 5 reputation with Thrallmar or Honor Hold, or 15 reputation on Heroic Mode.
Shadowmoon Technicians are trash mobs in the Blood Furnace wing of Hellfire Citadel who drop Proximity Mines and sticks of dynamite.

Shadrak Eaglebane, a barbarian, is a commander of the trolls of Zul'Aman, under Warlord Jin'zakk. He commands the troll braves and berserkers of various tribes to scour Zul'Aman's woods looking for intruders that might make for interesting sport or a good meal. The forest trolls rush to the attack, their fury and cleaving axe blades cutting down opponents swiftly and without mercy. On occasion, a coven of troll shamans accompany the berserkers to provide magical assistance.
The Shady Rest Inn quest chain deals the burnt Shady Rest Inn and discovering the culprits who destroyed it.
Shaffar's Wondrous Amulet is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest WANTED: Shaffar's Wondrous Pendant. The quest is a random daily heroic quest from Wind Trader Zhareem in Lower City.

Shadowsword Guardians are fel reavers located in the Sunwell Plateau under the control of the Shadowsword, a faction of Prince Kael'thas' Felblood elves. They patrol the hallway between M'uru and Kil'jaeden. They are extremely dangerous to non-plate wearers because of their charge ability.

Shadowy Tarot is an Inscription spell that creates one of five 'Demons' cards at random: * Ace of Demons, Two of Demons, Three of Demons, Four of Demons or Five of Demons. Combining one of each card creates a Demons Deck, which begins Darkmoon Faire quest Demons Deck (quest).
Shahiar was located on an island southeast of Hetaera's Clutch in Azshara. It was the pet of Loramus Thalipedes, along with Raytaf and Zaman.
Shadowmourne is the Feat of Strength achievement for obtaining Shadowmourne from Icecrown Citadel.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Drakonid are drakonid found at the Ata'mal Terrace of Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley.

Shadowplay is a common 3vs3 arena composition, which usually means consist of Warlock, Shadow Priest and Restoration Shaman. The name Shadowplay probably refers to the fact that most of Warlocks and Shadow Priests abilities are classified as school spells.

.]] Shadowy Apparitions is a passive Shadow priest ability. Each time Devouring Plague, Mind Blast, and Void Bolt are cast, a Shadowy Apparition is summoned against each target afflicted by Vampiric Touch. Shadowy Apparitions are shadowy versions of the caster that float slowly toward the afflicted target. Upon reaching their target, they deal instant shadow damage and disappear.

__NOTOC__ Shai Hu is a jinyu warrior found in Inkgill Ritual Island in Kun-Lai Summit. He was once an elder of Inkgill Mere that was corrupted by the sha when, for unknown reasons, he decided to drink from the newly-corrupted mere and forced many others of the town to do so. Once Waterspeaker Gorai cleansed the mere with an adventurer's help, he had no choice but to send them to kill Shai Hu in order to ensure that the corruption would not continue to spread.
Shadowwing Owls are owls found at the entrance of Shadowmoon Valley.
Shadowmoon Voidaxes are orcs located in Tanaan Jungle and in . They also attacked Karabor and the Lunarfall garrison.
Shadowmoon Voidclaws are orcs located in Anguish Fortress in .
Shadowmoon Voidwhisperers are orcs located in the Waning Crescent in . They are part of the Dark Emanation encounter.
Shadowmoon Void Priestessess are orcs located in the Burial Fields in .
Shadowmoon Treads is a transmoggable foot piece for cloth wearers.
Shadowmoon Valley Treasure Map is sold by in Stormshield for . This map is also rewarded from the garrison mission Tomb Raider.
Shadowmoon Sugar Pear Cider is created with Ogre Brewing Kit, but can also be bought from many vendors on .
__NOTOC__ Shal'dorei Insurgents are nightborne located in Suramar City.
The Shady Lady is a black market found in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. It is owned by Quincy Cutler.
Shadowsworn Invaders are doomguard located in the Chamber of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras. They are killed when Goroth crashes into the room.
Shadowy Decoy is a target dummy located in Dazar'alor. Skaggit also summons it on Island Expeditions.
Shadowy Essence is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadowmoon Talbuk is a talbuk located in Starfall Outpost in .
Shadowstalking Jerkin is sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Boots are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Gloves are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Hood is sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Britches are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Shoulders are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Waistband is sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Shadowstalking Bindings are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
__NOTOC__ Shadowmoon Warriors are orcs located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak.
Shadowmoon War Hounds are wolves located at Gorefiend's Vigil in the Black Temple.
Shankys is a level 30 fishing vendor located in the Valley of Honor in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. She's found at Lumak's Fishing.

Shamrock Reef is a series of islands located somewhere on Azeroth. There is lush greenery in every direction, but nary a spare coin to be found. Still, with a wee bit o' luck, adventurers and their neighbors can earn a bounty by slaying any beasties nearby.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps2.shtml]

Shalandis Isle is the base of the night elven expedition, the Sentinel spies, in the Ghostlands. A ship is docked off the coast. They have plans which involve spying on the blood elves from the high elven moon crystals at An'owyn and An'daroth.
__NOTOC__ Shard of the Virtuous is an one-handed mace that gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, spell power, and spirit.
Shalehusk Boots are a pair of Level 51 quality Plate Boots that improve Strength, Stamina and Dodge.

Shalrath is a wyrmkin dragonspawn of the black flight. Her father, Madaggan wishes to see the Alliance vacate from Theramore and sends Shalrath to assist a group of Theramore deserters assassinate Jaina Proudmoore. Shalrath provides the defectors with a obsidian statue resembling a black dragon infused with necromatic energies.
The Shaleskin flayers are a pack of rock flayers settled in the southwestern island of Netherstorm.

Shaman have the ability to put temporary elemental buffs on their weapons. Only one buff can be active on a weapon at any time. Dual-wielding Enhancement Shaman can put separate buffs on their Main-hand and Off-hand weapons.
Shalewind Canyon is an area in the eastern part of Redridge Mountains, near Stonewatch Falls, with a small Human encampment.
Shannox is a flamewaker boss of the Firelands raid instance. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 30.6.2011 by Stars - TW-Crystalpine Stinger.

Shalasyr was once a novice priestess of the Temple of Elune some ten thousand years ago. Being or having been priestesses during that time, Tyrande Whisperwind, Shandris Feathermoon and Maiev Shadowsong all knew her to some extent.

Shan Kien is a very old mogu that has been around since the :Divine Bell was hidden away. He is also the sole person to know of its hidden location. After he is defeated in the Tomb of Shadows, and nearly killed by Garrosh, he is placed in chains and taken away by the blood elves of Silvermoon. Eventually, he is brought to Garrosh'ar Advance where Baine Bloodhoof creates a :Memory Wine for the hero to drink in order to discover the bell's location. This is the last time Shan Kien is seen, and it's unknown what became of him, though he was likely killed by Garrosh.

Shan'ze Celestial Shapers, also known as the Hands of Shan Bu, are four mobs in the Throne of Thunder. Similar to how Shan Bu attempted to bend Niuzao to his will, these Mogu sorcerers appear to be attempting to shape the power of the August Celestials to their own purposes. When players defeat them, the essences of the four Celestials thank the heroes by aiding them in their battle with the Twin Consorts.

There are a number of Shamanstones found all over Frostfire Ridge. Players must get within a few yards of any given Shamanstone to unlock that Shamanstone's buff. Once unlocked, players can choose which one of six permanent buffs they will have in Frostfire Ridge from the Shamanstone at Frostwall, the Horde garrison, just southeast of the flight path. Buffs can be swapped between at any time while at the garrison.
The Shard of Scorn drops for agility and strength users from the Frenzied Golem at Liadrin's Watch in central Talador. For intellect users, the golem drops the Shard of Contempt (dagger) instead.
Shalaa is a draenei flight master located at Light's Rest in Talador.
Shard of Potentiation grants 10 Artifact Power when used at the Class Hall's forge.

Shar'gel is a planet in the Great Dark Beyond where the draenei refugees aboard the Genedar once attempted to seek refuge from the demonic Burning Legion. However, the Legion had lain in wait for them, and the draenei had barely managed to set foot on the world before demonic portals opened all around them, cutting off their retreat to the Genedar. The priestess Askara used her staff, T'uure, to shield the draenei from the Legion's onslaught and allow them to retreat to the dimensional ship. Along with seventy other defenders, Askara volunteered to stay behind on Shar'gel to stall the Legion's forces and allow their kin to flee to safety. Though the seventy-one eventually fell to the Legion,

Shard of a Dead World is a quest reward from Mark of the Sentinax (quest). It is also a reward from Duty's End. This item also drops from the following Legion Assaults commanders: *Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim *Dread Vizier Gra'tork in Val'sharah *Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain *Xeritas in Azsuna *Commander Vorlax in Azsuna

__NOTOC__ Shani Ward is a void elf innkeeper located outside the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. She is one of the first of her new race to travel to Stormwind after joining the Alliance, and has since established a small inn beside the main embassy.
Shapechanged Inquisitor is an inquisitor located in Stormwind City. He was taken out by the Uncrowned champions.
Shard of Xan was located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Shard of the Black Empire drops from the Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Shandai, Watcher of Cosmos drops from Ra-den in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Shard of Silvered Glass is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shard of Milkglass is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shard of Slath'gerrar is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shaohao's Might is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Shaohao.
Shard of Annihilation is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Shards of Annihilation.
Shambling Corpses are zombies located in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain. They release a Noxious Cloud upon death, lingering for a few moments.

Sharpbeak is a gryphon assisting the Wildhammer clan in the Hinterlands after being rescued from Vilebranch trolls. He is the son and heir of Swiftwing and Keenclaw who are all part of the Wildhammer fleet. According to Gryphon Master Talonaxe, he is destined to lead their next generation of gryphons. During the war against the Primalists, he was seen in the Zaralek Cavern as part of the Dragonscale Expedition, serving as a flight master.
__NOTOC__ Sharlindra is a banshee located in the Royal Quarter in the Undercity. Sharlindra was in contact with her lieutenant Melisara, who was looking for the Crown of Will.

The Shattered Halls is an elite instance in Hellfire Peninsula, being the third wing of Hellfire Citadel, with Kargath Bladefist as the final boss. The instance is one of the first endgame instances in players will encounter.
Shattered Hand Berserkers are fel orcs found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Hand Acolytes are fel orcs found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Hand Grenadier can be found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Hand Guards are fel orcs found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Hand Neophytes can be found in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Shattered Hand Sabatons is a world drop from any mobs in Outland.
Shattered Hand Warhound can be found in Hellfire Ramparts. They are the mounts of the fel orcs used at Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Necklace Ruby is contained in the Shadowforge Cache in Uldaman.
Shattered Necklace Topaz is contained in a Conspicuous Urn in Uldaman.

Shattered Necklace drops from the following mobs in the Badlands: * Shadowforge Surveyor * Stonevault Cave Hunter * Shadowforge Digger * Shadowforge Ruffian * Stonevault Rockchewer *And Stonevault Oracle in Uldaman
Shattered Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
The Shattered Fragments of Val'anyr are created by combining 30 Fragment of Val'anyr.

Shatter Rounds were crafted by Engineers who have specialized in Goblin Engineering, and have a minimum skill of 450. ;Materials (per 1000) :Crystallized Earth (2) The plans for this item were sold for 1 Primordial Saronite by Alchemist Finklestein in Light's Hammer in the lower spire of Icecrown Citadel, and requires reputation with The Ashen Verdict to purchase or use. (The bullets themselves have no such requirement.)
Sharptalon Eagles are eagles found in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

In The Shattered Halls, as you approach the gauntlet after Grand Warlock Nethekurse, this mob will shout out a warning. He'll run to the end of the hallway toward Blood Guard Porung, and then despawns. About the only time you'll see him up close is if the gauntlet bugs out and resets while you're in the hall or the room after.
Sharpshooter Guards are fel orcs located in Shattered Halls.

The Shattered Convoy is found on the path from Dustback Gorge in Valley of the Four Winds to the Temple of the Red Crane in the Forbidden Jungle of the western Krasarang Wilds. Ambassador Len and Sunwalker Dezco are found here.
Shattered Hand Torturers are orcs located at the Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Shattered Hand Bonechoppers are orcs located at the Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Shattered Hand Cutthroats are orcs located in Camp Thornscar in the Spires of Arak.
Shattered Hand Flayers are orcs located in Camp Thornscar in the Spires of Arak. They are riding Thornscar Ravagers.
Shattered Landing was established in response to the Iron Horde attack on Okril'lon Hold.
Shattered Hand Cache is found at in a tent in the Havesting Pits of northeastern Spires of Arak. It contains roughly 20 Garrison Resources.
The Shattered Hand Lookout is an orc located at Crow's Crook in the Spires of Arak. He is found next to a pile of Iron Horde Explosives (Spires of Arak)
Shattered Log drops from the following treants in Crystalsong Forest: *Unbound Ent *Dispirited Ent *Grove Walker It also dropped from Nightmare Figments.
Shattered Golem Fragments drop from arcane and Zandalari golems on the Isle of Thunder.
Shardmaster Azurrogg is a drogbar located inside the Crystal Fissure in Highmountain. He summons Rogg Shards.
Shardmaster Ufrogg is a drogbar located at the Crystal Fissure entrance in Highmountain.
Shattered King's Defender drops from the following in the Return to Karazhan dungeon: *Bishop *King *Knight *Rook
The Shattered Fields is the crystallized area created when the Xenedar skidded along the surface of Argus. Broken Army of the Light artillery batteries are scattered along the area.
The Shattered House Chest can be found in a house below the Shadowguard Incursion in Eredath.
Shattered Hand Blood-Twisters are orcs located at Bladefist Hold in the Spires of Arak.
Shattered Hand Blood-Singers are orcs located in Spires of Arak.
The Shattered Hand Cleaver was an orc located in Talador. She was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
__NOTOC__ The Shattered Locus is a chamber of the Temple of Fal'adora in Suramar. It houses a failed arcan'dor and is filled with corrupted dryads known as Shardmaidens.
Shattered Hand Stalkers are orcs located in the Spires of Arak.
Sharptooth Darters are groupers located in the Toothy Shallows on Mechagon Island.
The Shattered Dragonscale is left behind when infusing the Petrified Ebony Scale into the Heart Forge.
Shattered Felslate Seam is a mining vein found in Felmaw Cavern in Suramar.
The Shattered Helm of Domination is provided as an objective for Field Seance and Speaking to the Dead.
Shattered Hand Specialists are orc War Campaign troop units.
The Shattered Orbiter Crystal is looted from the Fallen Adventurer's Cache.
The Shattered Firestone is looted from the Fallen Adventurer's Cache.

The Shattered Grove is a location in an unspecified realm. It is reached, during Working for the Living, through a Broker Portal found at the Challenger's Promenade in Maldraxxus. Apart from mana rays, the area is mostly infested with devourers.
Sharkslayer Mugluk is a gorloc located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Shathhoth the Punisher is a n'raqi located in Island Expeditions.
Shath'Yar Scribes are night elves and jungle trolls located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
The Shattered Edge is a location on the Broken Shore during The Search for the Highlord and Vengeance Will Be Ours.
Shattered Pet Portal was originally Interdimensional Pet Portal.
Shattered Hand Dominators are orcs located in the Spires of Arak.
Shattered Hand Cutters are orcs located in Bladefist Hold in the Spires of Arak.
Shatterbone Skeletons are vrykul skeletons located in Trial of Valor.
Shattered Mementos are looted from Salvageable Items in the Shadowlands.
Shattered Crags are Azerite elementals located in southern Silithus: The Wound. They were killed by an Essence of Hati.
The Shattered Ornament drops from Sootscale the Indomitable at Nelthazan Ruins in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Shas'ith is a spider located in the halls below the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores. The enormous spider is trapped with several smaller Ravenous Nestlings behind a magical barrier.

The Shattered Hakkari Bijou is found beside a gong in the room full of ghosts beneath the Altar of the Blood God in Zul'Gurub. This item can be combined with a Fragmented Hakkari Bijou to create a Restored Hakkari Bijou.
Shattered Crystals are located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. They are typically found within a Stone Encasement.
Shattered Lightsword is looted from a Gilded Trunk. It summons an Ascended Vindicator on use.

Of all the flamewakers who followed Ragnaros into the world of Azeroth, Shazzrah is the most talented in the realm of the arcane. He is aware that his colleague Baron Geddon suspects the elemental Garr of treachery. The conflict between Baron Geddon and Garr suits Shazzrah well, for in fact it is Shazzrah who seeks to posses both halves of the Talisman of Elemental Binding so that he might find a way to siphon its energies for his own use. Ragnaros was very likely aware of his underling's penchant for duplicity when he split the talisman in half and entrusted the pieces to Baron Geddon and Garr. Shazzrah is an Arcane-based Flamewaker that shares a spawn area with Baron Geddon, guarding the R

The Shatterspear tribe is a tribe of jungle trolls that is located in Darkshore. They lived in prosperity until the tribe's decimation by the Alliance as a result of their recent allegiance with the Horde, though later returned during the attack on Teldrassil.

__NOTOC__ Sheldras Moontree is a night elf druid trainer who was originally located in Stormwind's Park until Deathwing's destruction of it, at which point he escaped, and then resided at the southernmost dock in Stormwind Harbor. Since the area was rebuilt, he is now located at the harbor and in Lion's Rest.

__NOTOC__ Shawn is a human child located on the Lakeshire docks in the Redridge Mountains. He wants to retrieve his friend Nida's necklace from the bottom of the lake and asks even members of the opposing faction to help him.
Sherman Femmel is a human meat vendor located in the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains.
Shatterstone Pick is one of the 3 quest rewards that can be chosen after completing the quest Beneath Thrallmar.
Shattrath Choker of Power is a quest reward from Maximum Security Breakout.

Sheza Wildmane is a tauren found on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She stands in front of a shop called Elder Rise Drums, and there are many drums stored in and around the hut behind her. During the Fourth War, she was robbed by the Venture Company. She owed a life debt to Atikka "Ace" Moonchaser.

The bag of Shattered Sun Supplies is a reward from the following daily quests: *Blast the Gateway *Discovering Your Roots / Rediscovering Your Roots *Intercepting the Mana Cells / Maintaining the Sunwell Portal *Sunfury Attack Plans (quest) *The Multiphase Survey — No longer awarded from this quest.
Shattered Sun Sentries are arcane guardians guards for the Isle of Quel'Danas. They appear during the Quel'Delar questline. They are also found in the Magisters' Terrace.

Shattered Sun Soldiers are wounded blood elves and draenei located in the Parhelion Plaza of Sunwell Plateau. They were wounded in action by the hostile Dawnblade and Arcane Guardians in the "disaster" that was first pull and were recalled by Captain Selana. They are now being tended to by Anchorite Elbadon and Neophyte Narama. Following Kil'jaeden's defeat, they entered the Sunwell chamber.

A Sheaf of Cards is a package of five pledge gifts, and is the first hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Undercity NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gift packages are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read any of the cards in a Sheaf of Cards. __NOTOC__

Shatterhorn is a giant yeti found in the Frostblade Peak in the Howling Fjord. Het has caused a disruption in mining operations in Wildervar Mine at Fort Wildervar. He needs to be wakened up first by placing a Giant Yeti Meal in front of it.
The Shattered Straits are a collection of shipwrecks and icebergs west of Westguard Keep and north of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Shattertusk Mammoths are mammoths found in northern Sholazar Basin.
The Shattered Walkway is a subzone of Ulduar that Kologarn guards. Kologarn must be killed in order to cross the pass to the Observation Ring since he is the bridge.
Shavalius the Fancy is the flight master for the small camp that is near the summoning stone for Ulduar.
Shatterplay is a common 3vs3 arena composition, which usually means consist of Frost Mage, Shadow Priest and Restoration Shaman.
Shecky Shrimpshoot is the stable master of the neutral goblin city of Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows.
__NOTOC__ Shatterskull Bonecrusher is shared boss loot from bosses in the Firelands.

Sheya Stormweaver is one of the sub-leaders of the Shatterspear tribe's forces in Darkshore, where she can be found floating in a water cyclone in the center of the Ruins of Mathystra, out of combat range.

.]] Shen-zin Su is a great turtle that roams Azeroth's oceans, which some pandaren named the Wandering Isle on which they explore the world outside Pandaria. Not merely a gigantic turtle, Shen-zin Su is a fully sentient being and quite aware of the pandaren that have been living on his back for generations.
Shelly is Tracker Lang's pet dragon turtle, located on the Golden Terrace of the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shatterstone is the domain of Alysrazor. It is a plateau in the shadow of an exploding volcano.

Sheepie is a prized sheep owned by sheep farmer Chee Chee, located around the Valley of the Four Winds. Though Chee Chee greatly cares for Sheepie, he is annoyed with the sheep's habit of wandering away from the rest of the flock and getting lost, having to ask adventurers to locate him several times. Sheepie's wandering, perhaps not surprisingly, ends up getting him killed by a Kunzen hozen, Krungko Fingerlicker. His devastated owner has the adventurer lure Krungko out and killed in revenge. After becoming best friends with Chee Chee, he mails a gift of Windwool Cloth woven from Sheepie's wool, and it's implied that the accompanying Exotic Leather was recycled from Sheepie's hide.
The Shattered Stone is the reward from the follower mission Where The Rock Flayers Went.
__NOTOC__ Sheena Sunweaver is a blood elf vendor located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Shattrath Overlook is an area accessible by an elevator located down in the Shattrath Residential District of in Talador. As it's name implies, it overlooks the city. The area is heavily corrupted by fel energies with many summoning gateways.
Shattered Rise is a subzone in the Spires of Arak on . It is a area.
__NOTOC__ Shel'zuul is a nathrezim that appears in Highmountain during a Legion Assault. He previously appeared at Legion Invasion locations.
Shattered Satchel of Cooperation is awarded for completing a class role that's in demand through Dungeon Finder or Raid Finder for Legion content.
Shell of Clear Speech is provided by Delandros Shimmermoon for The Fangs of Ashamane. It allows communication.
Shattered Sun Riftwakers are blood elf and draenei mages located in Sunwell Plateau. Following Kil'jaeden's defeat, they opened portals to Shattrath.
__NOTOC__ Shattered Sun Bombardiers are blood elves located on the Isle of Quel'Danas. They appear during The Air Strikes Must Continue.
Shattered Sun Recruits were blood elves located on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Shattered Sun Dragonhawk is a dragonhawk located on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Shem Dawson is Senior 3D Artist at Blizzard Entertainment. He made building structures for Warlords of Draenor, was responsible for the production of the Court of Stars and Black Rook Hold dungeons, and was content supervisor for Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Shattered Skulkers were orcs located in Lor'danel in Darkshore following the Burning of Teldrassil.
__NOTOC__ Shattershard is an Azerite fury located in Gloomtide Strand in Darkshore.

__NOTOC__ Shattered Rumblers are earth elementals located along the southern edge of Nagrand, in a distinctive but nameless region where the area is crumbling into the Twisting Nether. Some of those are disguised minions of Gurok.
Shattrath Firebreathers were draenei and blood elves located in Shattrath City. They were replaced by Master Fire Eaters.
Shgla'yos, Astral Malignity drops from the Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
The Shatterfall Pass is a path in Stormsong Valley which climbs towards Stormwatch Peak, ending at the Clearcut.
Shattereye's Chestguard is a quest reward from An Uneventful Stroll.
A Shattered Timequartz is left behind when infusing the Azerite-Encrusted Timequartz, Azerite-Infused Timequartz, Azerite-Fueled Timequartz, or Unburdened Azerite Timequartz into the Heart Forge.
__NOTOC__ Shattertusk Bulls are mammoths located in the Savage Thicket in Sholazar Basin.

The Shattered Relic was looted from containers like Mawsworn Caches and dropped from Conquering Korthia-required rare creatures in Korthia. This item was eventually replaced by Researching Korthian Relics (item).

Shattered Void Tablet can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 8 Cataloged Research and 4 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
The Shattered Span is a location within the Temple of Courage in Bastion. It lies west of Xandria's Vigil.
The Shattershield Arrow is provided as an objective for The Front Line.
The Shattering Totem is provided as an objective for Shaky Grounds.
Shattertusk Calves are mammoths located near the Glimmering Pillar in Sholazar Basin.
Shellack is an achievement reward from Glory of the Dragonflight Hero.

Shela the Windbinder is a tauren Primalist located on an islet just south of Ridgewater Retreat in the Ohn'ahran Plains. A servant of Koroleth, she used her storm magic to help Clan Nokhud slaughter the Ohn'ir mystics at the retreat in order to capture their totems and their ohuna. Tigari Khan sent her ohuna Altan to investigate the reports of an outsider working with the Nokhud, allowing Shela to capture the bird. __NOTOC__

The Shattrath Infirmary is a two-story infirmary located in the northern end of the Lower City in Shattrath. Here, the refugees who make their way to Shattrath are treated for their injuries. The infirmary is run by the Aldor healer Sha'nir, but the place is so understaffed that she accepts help from anyone, whether they are Aldor or Scryer.

The Shattrath orphanage is located in the eastern end of the Lower City of Shattrath. Run by the orphan matrons Nicole Bartlett and Mercy, it serves as a refuge for the children who've lost their parents to the deadly conflicts across Outland. It houses blood elf, draenei, human, and orc children, as well as babies of many other races. Priests sometimes visit the orphanage and tell the children stories. During Children's Week, adventurers can visit the orphanage to temporarily adopt one of two orphans: Dornaa (Alliance) or Salandria (Horde). __NOTOC__
Sherath is a green drakonid located in the Fields of Ferocity in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He and Taresh are known as Twin Dreamers champions.

Shimmer Ridge is located in northern Dun Morogh, west of the Gates of Ironforge. The ridge is inhabited by Frostmane trolls, who grow Shimmerweed, tame boars and dwell in two camps connected by a bridge. Young adventurers seek Shimmer Ridge out in order to collect the shimmer weed for an especially tasty ale recipe. During the war on Pandaria, an agent of Zandalar infiltrated Dun Morogh and rallied the Frostmane trolls. At Varian's request, Moira led her personal guard against them once the king's champions have stopped the magical storm and the trolls protecting Shimmer Ridge.
The Shining Silver Breastplate is a mail breastplate that gives a bonus to strength and stamina.

Shimmering Geta are cloth boots which had the highest MP5 (Restores X mana per 5 sec) in the game pre-BC, and were especially useful to Druids, Shamans and Priests in PvE boss fights, e.g. the Twin Emperors. These drop from Chromaggus (the second to last boss of Blackwing Lair) and are very useful as part of an alternative armor set for mana regeneration over long fights, although their use is limited in quick PvE bosses and in PvP combat.
Shiffar's Nexus-Horn is a powerful caster trinket that has a chance to give a buff to spell damage after criting.
Shiny Seashells can be looted from most level 6-12 humanoid monsters located near the ocean.
Shing Lightningpaw is a pandaren located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He can be found with Yuma Ironkettle. He can be saved in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Shin the Weightless is a pandaren flight master found at the Tavern in the Mists on the Veiled Stair.

__NOTOC__ Shifting Mireglobs are oozelings found in the Shifting Mire of the Swamp of Sorrows. They are created out of swamp mud but have the ability to move about of their own accord. Despite their mysterious nature they are uncorrupted by outside sources, being naturally produced by the swamp environment.
Shieldwall Explorers are dwarves located in Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit during To Mogujia (Alliance). One also appears in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Shieldstorm is an ability used by Murkalot during a Pet Battle.
Shining Protector is a passive ability learned by Protection paladins at level 50.

:"It's like being able to play with THREE angry chickens!" :— Flavor text Shifter Zerus is a small, shapeshifting creature who appears in the Whispers of the Old Gods expansion for Hearthstone. It appears somewhat similar to a miniature n'raqi, but seemingly has the ability to shapeshift into different creatures.
Shiny Silver Necklace is looted from Steamy Jewelry Box at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Shimmering Shells are a reward from Island Expeditions. They are also bought from Captain Zen'taga in Zuldazar for .

__NOTOC__ Shinga Deathwalker, also known as Shinga Deathserver, is a Zandalari troll ghost located at the Terrace of Sorrows in Nazmir. She and her husband were both priests of the loa Bwonsamdi at his shrine in Nazmir until they were slain by heretics who corrupted their son Kel'vax. She works with the Horde Speaker to destroy Kel'vax and bring him to Bwonsamdi.
Shieldwall Skirmishers are humans planned to appear during A Kind of Magic.
Shim Crankturner is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.
Shimmerflight Quills drop from etherwyrms, larions, cloudfeathers, and cranes in Bastion.
Shimmerwing Mothlings are moths found most commonly in northeastern Talador. They are often found flying in groups.
The Shifting Cryptogram drops from mobs in the Maw with higher chance from more powerful enemies.
Shimmerfly is a night fae faerie who is the historian of the dream trees found in Hibernal Hollow in Ardenweald.
Shimmerwing is a wind serpent located in Island Expeditions.
Shifting Signet is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shifting Sustenance is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shimmering Cloaktrails is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shimmering Wingcape is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Shikaar Hunting Horn is available at Renown level 23 with the Maruuk Centaur. It is a reward from Get on the Horn, and can also be purchased for from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Using it grants temporary access to your Grand Hunt abilities and companion. The item is consumed on use.

The Shifting Sands surround the Temporal Conflux in southern Thaldraszus. Affected by the shifting timeways, numerous time-lost creatures from across Azeroth and beyond have appeared, including arakkoa, devilsaurs, murlocs, quilboar, raptors, and thunder lizards. A small quest hub and is located near the Flowing Forest to the north. Azim, the flight master, has connections to the Temporal Conflux, Garden Shrine, and Gelikyr Post in Thaldraszus, and Theron's Watch in Azure Span. Three rare creatures also spawn in the sands: Lord Epochbrgl, Innumerable Ruination, and Phleep. Shoni the Shilent is a gnome quest giver located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. She is the commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew.

Shiv is a rogue class talent. It is a fairly weak attack with an off-hand weapon that applies a more powerful version of currently used non-lethal poison. Shiv is automatically learned for Assassination.

.]] Short John Mithril is a goblin pirate captain of the Bloodsail Pirates and an arena master in the Gurubashi Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He initiates the battle of the chest in regular intervals of every 3 hours. When the game clock strikes 12, 3, 6, or 9, Short John will start the battle. He also appears on Mechagon Island in search of murloc treasure.
Shizzle's Drizzle Blocker is a quest reward from Shizzle's Flyer.
Shizzle's Nozzle Wiper is a quest reward from Shizzle's Flyer.

__NOTOC__ Sholazar Tickbirds are critters that can be found in western Sholazar Basin. They're frequently seen sitting on the horns of Shardhorn Rhinos, or flying nearby. They can also land on tamed rhinos' horns.

Shot Through The Heart is an ability used by Peddlefeet during a Pet Battle.
Shock and Awe is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Shipwreck Arena is a subzone found in Azsuna. Sea giants in the court of Prince Oceanus use the area as a pet battle arena with captured slaves as the pets.

__NOTOC__ Shipwreck Cove is a cove on the northern coast of Highmountain where many ships have wrecked due to the perpetual heavy fog blanketing the area. The area has a heavy murloc presence. Both the hostile Swamprock and the friendly Murkloc tribe. At the western edge of the region, Steven Nelson has set up camp with Crafty Palu and Adaleigh Mae Nelson. To the east, the cove borders Clackbrine Coast. During Legion Assaults, the camp is defended by guards.
